_comment: Zapt Movers pricing and operations settings. Edit in /admin/pricing/ and download this file, or edit here directly and redeploy. Every number the booking calculator uses lives in this file.
_googleMapsKey: The Maps key is NOT stored here. It lives in the GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY environment variable in Netlify and is served by /api/config. Putting it in this file fails the build, because Netlify scans committed files for credentials.

productivity._cuftPerMoverPerHour: How many cubic feet one mover loads AND unloads per hour. Lower it if your quotes keep coming in short.
productivity._stairsFlightPenaltyPct: Extra time per flight of stairs, as a percentage of labor hours.

_crew: First row whose maxCuft is not exceeded wins. Stairs and heavy items can push this up one crew size automatically.
_hourlyRates: Dollars per hour by crew size, truck included.
_trucks: Usable capacity, not the manufacturer number. Leave headroom for pads and awkward loads.

travel._doubleDriveTime: California requires charging double the drive time between addresses on local moves.

_fees: auto:true means it is always added. The others are triggered by what the customer selects.

protection._tvCratingPerTv: Per TV, charged when the customer adds TV protection.
protection._fullValueProtectionPctOfEstimate: Optional upgrade beyond the included basic coverage.

quote._rangePaddingPct: The customer sees a range. This is how far above and below the calculated total it spreads.
